name: @mandate/pack-format
description: World format v2: pack schemas (Zod), the validator, the source-to-pack generator and its staleness check. Runs at build time and at pack load, outside the kernel.

mandate.reason: Build-time and load-time pack tooling: it depends on Zod and intl-messageformat (npm packages the kernel may not import) and its CLI reads and writes pack files. Its output is World data, which the kernel hashes; the generator's output is checked byte for byte on Linux and Windows.
